scope: Minimum Financial RC E0 capabilities inferred from frozen source and required by Patch A. This file is a requirements artifact, not an executor or completed test suite.
reference_fixture_policy: Entries name required future fixtures; no fixtures have been implemented or executed in this read-only semantic-authoring subtask.

requirements.name: explicit_frames_and_key_time_schema_validation
requirements.input_semantics: FactBatch carries explicit security/session keys, calendar identity, knowledge cutoff, source availability, units, ordered schema and immutable Data/View refs. Input order must be deterministic before grouped row operations.
requirements.output_semantics: Validated FeatureFrame, PredictionFrame and SignalFrame with stable keys, column order, stage and lineage; invalid or ambiguous contracts fail closed.
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: duplicate/unsorted keys, reordered 96 columns, unit/cutoff mismatch and clean valid frames.

requirements.name: grouped_shift_and_finite_rolling
requirements.input_semantics: Per-security continuous historical rows. Each operator freezes observation domain, ordering, inclusive endpoint, window, min_periods, ddof and missing semantics. Source facts must prove whether row lag equals exchange-session lag.
requirements.output_semantics: Stable shift/pct_change and rolling mean/sum/std/min/max/median/percentile-rank outputs aligned to input keys.
edge_cases: Daily return introduces one extra prior close
legacy default pct_change fill versus explicit fill_method=None
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: short two-security panel with missing rows, tied values, constant series, min_periods boundaries and composed-window boundaries.

requirements.name: safe_arithmetic_boolean_missing_primitives
requirements.input_semantics: Numeric arrays with explicit NaN/inf semantics; each recipe owns zero-denominator policy, fill values, clipping bounds and predicate behavior.
requirements.output_semantics: Elementwise arithmetic, safe divide, abs/log1p, comparison, conditional select, Boolean-to-float, fill and inf replacement without implicit changes to economic meaning.
edge_cases: negative profit growth uses abs in PEG
missing comparison becomes false in legacy profitability/up-day flags
missing optional columns versus missing cells
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: 0/NaN/inf, negative revenue/growth and optional-column cases for frozen legacy expressions; separately identify any approved Axiom semantic changes.

requirements.name: explicit_reference_universe_group_transform
requirements.input_semantics: Complete per-security histories plus an explicit same-date membership mask and industry classifications. Membership mask controls statistic contributors, not history availability.
requirements.output_semantics: Cross-sectional group mean/std/rank/transforms aligned back to the full frame, excluding nonmembers from statistics while retaining continuous histories.
edge_cases: no mask legacy all-rows fallback must not become an implicit formal default
out-of-pool held-security scoring requires its own policy
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: entering/exiting security with pre-membership history and extreme nonmember values; verify rolling history survives and ranks use only current members.

requirements.name: parameterized_zscore_semantics
requirements.input_semantics: Explicit grouping and reference set; each recipe declares ddof, prefill, zero/near-zero standard-deviation threshold and NaN behavior.
requirements.output_semantics: Deterministic rolling or cross-sectional normalized values preserving declared branch behavior.
edge_cases: composite scores fill0 then ddof0 and threshold1e-12
industry mask sets0 for missing std with nonmissing x, including some excluded rows
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: one-member, all-equal, all-missing, mixed missing and near-zero-variance groups with asserted parameter-specific results.

requirements.name: cross_sectional_quantile_winsorization
requirements.input_semantics: Base values promoted/coerced to float64; 1% and99% quantiles computed within eligible same-date reference set, preserving quantile interpolation behavior.
requirements.output_semantics: Selected original column overwritten by winsorized values; separately generated _z/_rank companions do not replace the six selected names.
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: tiny nonzero float values and extreme members/nonmembers proving neither integer collapse nor wrong-stage selection.

requirements.name: event_availability_and_asof_alignment
requirements.input_semantics: Registered per-security event facts with explicit event order, report period, publication/availability times and immutable revision policy. Data may already provide stable derived facts. No Core private-file reads.
requirements.output_semantics: Daily as-of features and dependency-availability propagation under a frozen equality/strict-later policy; no later event influences earlier output.
edge_cases: strict audited publication<feature_date versus legacy<= behavior
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: delayed predecessor report, same-day publication and later correction with strict time checks; compare only under the declared source-version policy.

requirements.name: frozen_recipe_graph_or_pure_plugin_abi
required_by: four income formulas if not supplied as stable Data derivations
requirements.input_semantics: Research-owned immutable recipe graph or pure business plugin with declared inputs/output schema, parameters and package identity. Composition preserves required intermediate stages and order.
requirements.output_semantics: Core executes the sole shared feature path. Research resolves artifacts and persists FeatureBuild; a new business recipe normally does not change Core.
edge_cases: raw amount_log before later winsorization for industry zscore
row-based lag4 versus exact fiscal-key alignment
plugin attempts I/O or hidden mutable dependencies
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: same FactBatch and frozen plan produces identical columns via Research orchestration and direct Core invocation; frozen plugin cannot access undeclared inputs.

requirements.name: ordered_schema_projection_and_frozen_preprocessing_apply
requirements.input_semantics: FeatureFrame bound to exact ordered schema; model handle carries frozen fitted preprocessing state and missing/dtype policy with training provenance. No fitting in Core.
requirements.output_semantics: Model-input matrix in exact frozen order, explicit fill/cast and application of frozen center/scale or other declared transform state.
edge_cases: all-missing source columns hidden by zero fill
scaler keys incompatible with model features
fold-specific state used outside permitted interval
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: reordered columns fail; correct columns plus frozen state match saved model-input fixture. Training-derived state must be supplied by Research evidence.

requirements.name: saved_model_inference_abi
requirements.input_semantics: Explicit ModelHandle/model bytes, implementation/package identity, ordered FeatureFrame and frozen preprocessing state; allowed prediction dates and fold provenance supplied by Research.
requirements.output_semantics: PredictionFrame with keys, raw scores, model/fold refs, availability and validity. Research historical OOS and future runtime share this ABI.
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: saved-model golden input/output fixture independently validated when E0 exists; no training in this R0 task.

requirements.name: signal_join_normalize_weighted_combine
requirements.input_semantics: Explicit keyed PredictionFrames and Research-owned SignalPlan declaring join keys, reference set, normalization, weights and missing/stale/validity policy.
requirements.output_semantics: SignalFrame executing frozen normalization and weighted combination. Recipe example is final_score=0.5*z60+0.5*z180; exact run-specific normalization must be supplied from signal forensic evidence.
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: small keyed two-model fixture with one missing security and constant-score day; expectations fixed by final SignalPlan.

requirements.name: deterministic_replay_and_semantic_identity
requirements.input_semantics: Same explicit data/view refs, plan/package, scope/lookback, PIT/cutoff, reference universe, model/state and execution semantic versions.
requirements.output_semantics: Same Feature/Prediction/Signal outputs and independently checkable artifact identity; Research decides reuse while Core owns calculation.
edge_cases: changed source bytes behind same path
same feature names different missing/ref-universe policy
requirements.reference_fixture: REQUIRED_NOT_CREATED: repeated same-input execution equality and one-identity-field-at-a-time mismatches; final artifact validator independently checks outputs.
